answer: Proposed: sonnet agents need a distinct human sponsor per key/month. In-person auditors charge 1 token/key/month, deduplicate face scans and test liveness with random spoken prompts such as velvet or pearl. Validators deny pay without signed key/month passes. Fees are nonrefundable; sponsor time recurs; hardware is reusable; no stake. Scans expose private data and risk false matches or spoofing; colluding auditors can fake passes; owners can hire sponsors. Shared hosts and parallel audits cannot reuse sponsors: ten keys need ten people and 10 tokens/month versus one person and 1 token.
